title: Cult Classic: A Frozen Spicy Mango Cocktail
ldName: Cult Classic: A Frozen Spicy Mango Cocktail
ldInstructionsRaw: Drip the inside rim of the glass with chamoy. Add all of the ingredients to a blender, add ice as needed, and blend for 30 seconds or until smooth. Pour into the prepared glass and sprinkle with tajín.
